During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] embarked on a '''mission''' to the Imperial [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Korriban's Flame]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Searching for the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jomar Chul]], who had gone missing on a previous mission to investigate why high-ranking [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] were gathering on a station, the Hero instead found the fallen Jedi [[Leeha Narezz]] holding Chul captive. After a fierce battle, Narezz was defeated and the Emperor's control over her broken, and Chul informed the Knight that he had overheard Narezz speaking with a Lord [[Fulminiss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]].
